entries.note: The shipment was booked, often by a merchant's system at night, days before a warehouse scan.

entries.wording: Aún no tenemos tu envío. ¡Te esperamos en Olva!
entries.note: Booked by a sender who has not yet brought the parcel to an Olva store.
The store named took the parcel in from its sender. REPARTO files every move after the booking; its wording says which.
At the warehouse of the town named, on the way out or at the destination.

entries.wording: En camino a la TIENDA: OLVA GAMARRA
entries.note: On its way to the store where the recipient collects it.
Arrived at the warehouse of a town on the route, the destination's included, under the title "En camino a destino".
Out with the courier to the recipient's address.

entries.wording: Ya puedes recoger tu envío en TIENDA OLVA GAMARRA
entries.note: Waiting at the store named for the recipient to collect it.
A delivery failed; the reason follows the colon, here nobody at the address. The page colors incidents red.
Delivered at the address or collected from the store.
